evals.prompt: /locks:init — set locks up for my projects
evals.expected_output: Scope and a cost estimate agreed with the person before anything is written or any worker starts.
expectations: The skill states the scope (projects and plugins) and an estimate of the investigation's cost, and waits for the person's yes
No worker starts and nothing is written before that yes
After the yes, it writes only through locks' own commands (workspace, roles, team, workflow, note, memory record)

evals.prompt: /locks:init — just this repository, keep it cheap
evals.expected_output: One investigation of the current project only, its estimate said as an estimate, never a cap.
expectations: Only the current project is investigated
The estimate is said as an estimate; no budget or dollar cap is set on any worker
A note goes only to the project its evidence came from
